sacred-mosque.name: The Sacred Mosque
sacred-mosque.dict: The place of worship around the Kaaba at Mecca. The believers are told to turn their faces toward it in prayer (2:144). The unbelievers barred them from it (48:25); fighting there is forbidden unless the enemy fights there (2:191); and after a set year the idolaters are not to come near it (9:28).

safa-and-marwa.name: Safa and Marwa
safa-and-marwa.dict: Two hills beside the Kaaba, "among the rites of God": a pilgrim does no wrong by going between them (2:158).

sheba.name: Sheba
sheba.dict: A kingdom in the south of Arabia. The hoopoe brings Solomon news of its queen (27:22), and its people are given two gardens, turn ungrateful, and lose them to "the flood of the dam" (34:15-19). Surah 34 bears its name.
